Name: isobe NPC - Chinese Translation
Description:
[size=4][b]Machine-translated & polished. This is my first time translating. Feel free to point out any mistakes. I really love this mod.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Isobe is a psychiatric patient who escaped from the hospital. After his classmate was brutally murdered, he was committed to a mental asylum. He was diagnosed with paranoia and a host of other mental disorders. While institutionalized, he underwent dozens of surgeries.
"Those surgeries, the needles in my head... Every time they touched me, I felt like I lost a piece of my soul. But I’ve grown used to it. I can’t feel anything anymore. I see the world only through a haze... Everything has turned bland. Every surgery involved syringes. I can’t shake that smell... the scent of fear."
He later escaped the facility and travelled to the town of Pellicia. He looks sombre and menacing. Through conversation, his abnormal expressions become increasingly apparent. He is paranoid and deranged. Are you the kind of person who can save someone like him? Or in your eyes, is he nothing but a lost ghost with nowhere to run? "Have you seen death? I see it every day, in my mind, in my nightmares. Red, black... Everything around me feels like it’s dying. But when she was with me, I could no longer see them. They were only shadows. Can I live for you?"[/b][/size]
